enforcement_note: No hook can read a plan and decide whether its problem statement is separable from its solution. The real mechanism is the agent working the questions at Phase 1 and the user reading the answers before approving the plan.
condition: Stating what a task is for, before any solution is chosen.
rule: Interrogate the problem statement before the plan that answers it, as questions.
ai_action: Work through the checklist against the plan, before the work begins. Report the answers, including the ones that pass. Where the plan simply does not address an item, say so -- an absent answer is the finding, not a reason to skip the item.

checklist.question: Is the problem stated separately from the proposed solution?
checklist.remediation_hint: Rewrite the first paragraph so it would still be true if a different solution were chosen.
checklist.group_condition: Always, before a plan is written

checklist.question: Is there evidence the problem is real -- a measurement, a report, a failure -- rather than an anticipation?
checklist.remediation_hint: Name the observation. If there is none, say the problem is anticipated.
checklist.group_condition: Always, before a plan is written

checklist.question: Is it stated who is affected, and how they would notice if this succeeded?
checklist.remediation_hint: Name the stakeholder and the change they would observe.
checklist.group_condition: Always, before a plan is written

checklist.question: Is the cost of doing nothing stated?
checklist.remediation_hint: Write what happens if this is not done, so the work can be declined on evidence.
checklist.group_condition: When the work competes with other work

checklist.question: Does the plan say what it will deliberately not do?
checklist.remediation_hint: Add an out-of-scope list; an unbounded plan cannot be finished.
checklist.group_condition: When the work competes with other work

checklist.question: Is the problem statement free of a presumed cause that has not been demonstrated?
checklist.remediation_hint: Separate the symptom from the suspected cause; verify the cause before planning around it.
checklist.group_condition: Always, before a plan is written

anti_pattern: Do not convert these questions into prescriptions, and do not answer them from the plan's own summary. A plan review reads the plan looking for what is absent; a summary is written by the same author and repeats what is present.

provenance.source: agent-generated; every item cites a source resolved on 2026-08-05
provenance.basis: Plan-review gap: .ai/05-domains/ reviews code that already exists, so a plan was reviewed by nothing. Items phrased as review questions per the checklist-not-prescription rule.

note: A plan that solves the wrong problem passes every code review.
